title: We drew lots of monsters, and then we showed them to the teacher.
scene: 问他和朋友今天干了啥。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did you and Sam do together today?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We drew lots of monsters, and then we showed them to the teacher.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What did she say about your monster?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: She said that mine was the scariest one.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yes, because mine had three eyes on it.

variations: "drew monsters" 换 "built a fort"；"showed the teacher" 换 "showed Mom"。
